title: Yeasty Middle-Eastern Hummus Tagine
description: A yeast-infused twist on the classic Middle Eastern dip, featuring a light and airy texture. Serve with pita or vegetables for a delightful snack.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and 1/2 cup warm water in a bowl. Mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down dough and mix in hummus, olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Knead dough for an additional 2 minutes until smooth.
Shape dough into a ball and place in a greased 9-inch round cake pan.
Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
While warm, use a whisk to aerate the hummus and create a light and airy texture.
Serve with pita or vegetables for a delightful snack.
Optional: garnish with parsley or sumac for added flavor and color.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
